user.title: Solar Visor
user.description: Makes the Solar Visor hub reachable for the apps at this Home Assistant's address (/api/solar_visor) – wherever Home Assistant is reachable. Host and ports of the hub: the add-on is found automatically; a hub running elsewhere is entered here.

error.cannot_connect: No Solar Visor hub answers at this address.
error.incompatible: The hub is too old for this integration – please update the Solar Visor Hub add-on.

abort.already_configured: Solar Visor is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Solar Visor is already set up.

hub_incompatible.title: Solar Visor hub and integration do not match
hub_incompatible.description: The Solar Visor hub does not understand this integration's forwarding. Please update the Solar Visor Hub add-on and the integration to their latest versions.
